title: Finite-integral function entropy
source_anchor: Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling, August20 2026, §2.3.1, printed pp60–61: supporting core only
target_statement: For a measurable space X, a measure m, and a real function g, define its real function entropy by the difference of the integral of g log g and the mean of g times the logarithm of that mean. Applications below impose integrability explicitly; this literal real formula is not an extended-real entropy.
